basic_info.description: Brimming with natural light and built for flexible living, 515 Goettingen is a lovely, well-maintained single-family home in the vibrant Portola District. This spacious residence has four bedrooms and two baths and offers a versatile floor plan ideal for multi-generational living or remote work. The main level features a gracious living room with oversized front-facing windows, a formal dining room, and an interior covered patio, illuminating the space and providing an ideal spot for happy plants. The updated kitchen includes ample cabinetry, stone countertops, and an adjacent breakfast nook. Two generous upstairs bedrooms open to a wide terrace spanning the width of the home overlooking a mature garden oasis, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. A full bathroom with a classic soaking tub completes this level. Downstairs, you'll find two additional roomy bedrooms with garden access and a second full bathroom with a walk-in shower. The expansive garage offers room for parking, storage, or even a workshop or home gym. Great location near McLaren Park, Palega Recreation Center and shops along San Bruno Avenue. Quick freeway access makes commuting a breeze. With space to grow and charm to spare, this sweet retreat is ready to welcome you home.
